Not all heroes wield swords… some prefer the spoon!

Beastro launches on PlayStation 5 May 21, 2026.

In Beastro, the key to saving the world is a really good meal. Play as Panko, a young and talented chef whose teacher goes missing, leaving him to step up and take over the restaurant. Serve the Caretakers, brave adventurers sent to save the world, and watch your meals energise them and shape the turn-based, deckbuilding combat they recount to you each evening.

Craft thoughtful meals, balance flavour profiles, sharpen your skills, and unlock a plethora of abilities...

Because who can save the world on an empty stomach?

Hunted on a frozen planet, astronaut Ariane must brave rugged landscapes and shifting realities to rescue her wounded partner, Thomas.

About the game  

As ESA astronauts Ariane and Thomas, explore and survey an uncharted planet and solve the mystery of your crash landing, all while trying to survive in the terrifying presence of an unknown enemy. At its heart, Aphelion is an emotional tale about love, resilience, hope, and what we bring with us when everything is lost.   

A game in collaboration with ESA, the European Space Agency. 

Aphelion launches on PS5 on April 28, 2026.

Fight your way through a haunting, ever‑evolving world on an adrenaline‑fuelled journey as you uncover the true cost of your power.

SAROS delivers razor‑sharp, gameplay‑first combat on a shape‑shifting Carcosa ruled by a mysterious Eclipse. Every encounter is designed to feel dangerous yet fair, where failure isn’t the end, but part of a transformative loop where each death fuels progression and unlocks new opportunities.

Featuring empowering combat, emotional depth, and a world built on mystery and consequence, SAROS challenges you to understand the cost of rising to a higher power.
